title: Casey & Miles
endHeadline: Want to know what else he's hiding?
endSubhead: Miles came back from Los Angeles with two nights he still hasn't explained, and an answer for every question except that one.

onboardingContent.text: Word is you're the best there is at stalking. So… here I am. I need you.
onboardingContent.caption: Casey

onboardingContent.text: Miles and I have been together three years. Three years of laughing, travelling, building plans. We'd started talking about a wedding, a house, kids. It was supposed to be perfect.
onboardingContent.caption: Casey & Miles

onboardingContent.text:
Then he came back from that "business trip"  and everything shifted. 
He barely answered my messages while he was gone… and I haven't stopped doubting since. 
My gut says he's hiding something.
onboardingContent.caption: Miles

onboardingContent.text: So yes… I did something insane: I'm handing you a copy of his phone. Messages, notes, apps — all of it is yours. I'll ask the questions while you dig. Over to you.
onboardingContent.caption: Casey

messages.text: Someone gave me your name. Said you find what people try to hide.
Can I ask what to call you?
Thank you. I'm sorry, I don't know how to say this bit.
My boyfriend Miles just got back from a work trip in Los Angeles, and there are two nights he still can't explain... I'm sending you a photo of him.
He's asleep. I have his phone, but not for long.
{{name}}, please. There's nobody else I can ask.

msgs.text: Did you watch the game last night?? It was INSANE 🔥
God yes! I screamed the place down at that 89th minute goal 😭
Craving ramen so badly tonight
Ramen night it is then!
My parents want us over for Easter
Works for me! Is your mother cooking?
Obviously! And she's counting on you to help
Happily, cooking with her is the best part
Did you remember your vitamins today?
Ah no... forgot them again
Miles! It's important for your health
Alarm is on my phone now
I want us to do a surprise weekend
Where? Got an idea?
Nope, exactly! We leave without knowing where
That's the whole point! Count me in
Look outside, snow! ❄️
Wow, that hasn't happened in years
Could we build a snowman?
What are you, five? 😂 But yes, let's go
I dreamt we got a dog last night
Big dog or little dog?
A golden retriever! He was way too cute
One day, when we've got a house with a garden
Can you wake me up tomorrow if I hit snooze too much? 🙃
Haha, Milo will be deployed on wake-up duty
Out of the station at last 🚄
About time 😅 are you holding up okay?
Pretty wrecked yeah... grabbing a coffee then heading to the airbnb
Okay baby, text me when you get settled in 💙
All settled ✅ bags are away and I'm going through my emails
Morning was relentless... nothing but calls 😵‍💫
Stay strong my heart 🫶 When do you get to eat?
Around 1 p.m. if nothing overruns
Drink some water at least, please 😅
Break done 🙌 hoping this afternoon is gentler
Two more things and I'm out of the office
And what's the plan for tonight?
One of the guys here put me onto a restaurant, sounds like he knows Los Angeles well 😅
Nice! Make the most of it 🥰
I'll check it out and tell you after ❤️
Text me when you're back safe, okay
It's okay, I'm back, I'm getting tired now
OK sweetheart... Was the restaurant good?
Yeah so good 😋 Night baby, love you
Night night my love ❤️
Did you sleep okay?
Ugh... up since 6am because the neighbor is doing construction 🔨🙃
Oh no, what an idiot... hope he doesn't keep it up
I hope it's done by the time you get home tomorrow
Yeah me too
Good luck on your last day! Work hard 😘
Thanks baby ❤️
What time are you home tonight? Can I call you?
Miles? You there?
Hello?? Miles???
It really bothers me when you go quiet like this...
Fine... good night then
Sorry no more battery...
Sorry for last night, I left my charger at the office...
Great... You could warn me before it cuts out, right?
I know...sorry really
On the train 🚆 should be in between 2 p.m. and 3 p.m.
Okay text me when you’re getting close
I promise... counting the hours until I see you ❤️
Me too
And we need to talk
Casey... please answer
I love you
Got handed a new project at work... stressful
What sort of project?
Rebuilding the whole system from scratch
You'll smash it, no question
So, how did Los Angeles go?
Good... draining but productive
Nice! Wanna hang soon?
Yeah, I'm up for that
Is the Los Angeles trip this week?
yeah Tuesday... 3 days of work
cool! bring us back some treats 😋
😂 if there is any time!
back from Los Angeles?
yeah it's okay... a little exhausted
makes sense! catch up this week?
yeah we’ll call each other
Yes mom, train later today
Good! Safe trip back then
Thanks mom! See you tomorrow
Are you on the train, sweetheart?
Yes mom! Should be in around 2 p.m.
Perfect ! Take a good rest this weekend, you look tired right now
Yeah, true... but I'll be fine
Look after yourself, my heart
Yes really well! The clients are nice
Good. What day are you back?
Tomorrow evening, all being well
Okay son. Good luck wrapping up
Are you on that train yet?
Yes dad, I get in around 2pm
Good! Get some rest this weekend
Thanks dad
quick one, what day do you leave for Los Angeles?
Tuesday morning, I have a few work meetings there
nice! take the chance to do a little sightseeing at least
yeah, if there's a gap I will
got to Los Angeles in one piece bro! pouring with rain though
😂 let me guess... you already found a coffee shop
obviously! you know me 😮‍💨 anyway I don't care
ugh a day of 100% video calls... I can't take it anymore
😂 so you're seeing Los Angeles through Teams then?
Exactly! world class sightseeing 👌
Gil... I have to tell you something. I had a match on Tinder here
What ?! But since when have you been on Tinder? 😳
installed it yesterday... honestly just curious at first
and Casey in all this...?
It's complicated at the moment... I got tired of Casey I think
so what's the plan tonight then?
just a quiet restaurant, nothing big, we'll talk a while
just be careful man
no worries, the phone is going off for a bit tonight
man yesterday was wild... crazy connection with Mar
oof... so now what do you do?
we're seeing each other again tonight... I got an Airbnb near her place. we'll probably sleep together
Miles... be really careful, think hard about what you're doing
I know, I know... tomorrow I'll tell you everything, promise
right, heading off... you probably won't reach me tonight
okay man... keep me posted tomorrow for sure
hey! on the train back
so... did Casey find out anything?
probably... she fired off a few strange texts this morning
hang in there man... we'll talk about it tonight, quietly
and what are you gonna tell her if she asks?
already wrote it all down in my notes... don't judge me
Hi, can you pick me up tomorrow at 7am on Lafayette Street?
Confirmed, driver will be there at 7
Great, thanks. See you in the morning
Hey, could you send over last month's report?
sure, sending it over in 5
Thanks 👍
Sent, let me know if everything looks good
great, flawless as usual
Got your number at last! 😊
Bye Tinder — texting's so much better than that app
Completely agree! So, still on for tomorrow night?
Wouldn't miss it 😌
Any food you're picky about, or should I be surprised too
Not picky at all. Though I'd never say no to Italian 🍝
Okay, Italian is literally my love language. You're dangerous 😏
Already got a place in mind. I'll book it, send you the pin tomorrow
Can't wait to actually meet you, Miles
Same. Tomorrow can't come fast enough 😊
So, what brings you to Los Angeles? Are you there on vacation? 😊
Work. Client stuff, unfortunately
Boo. What's the job then?
Tech consulting. Your turn
Interior designer — which is exactly why I have opinions about where we eat 😉
Nice. Anything I'd recognize?
A few restaurants, a couple of apartments around LA. I just like building a mood, honestly
Morning, sleepyhead. Did you sleep well? ❤️
Slept great, thanks 😊 you ready for tonight?
So ready. Outfit's been picked since Tuesday 😅
Okay now I feel underdressed already
Just relax. I'm sure we'll have a great time 😊
So. This mystery restaurant 😊
Small Italian spot, really cozy. A friend swears it's basically built for first dates
Italian?! You remembered 😍 Send me the address?
Booked us a table for 8 tonight — meet out front?
8 works. How do I spot you?
Tall, dark hair, black coat. Your turn
Jeans, gray sweater, tall-ish. We'll find each other 😊
Counting the hours. See you soon, Miles
Tonight was actually magical. Thank you 🌟
Best night I've had in ages, honestly
I don't say this lightly but I think we've got something real here. Been a while since I felt that
Same page here. I don't want to wait too long to see you again
Good, because I already miss you. Sleep well ❤️
Good night Mar
Hey stranger... you were in my dream last night 😊
Hope it was a good dream at least
It was. What's your day looking like?
Couple of calls this morning, then wide open. You?
Dead slow at the office. Mostly just thinking about seeing you again
Same here. Tonight?
So, tonight — your call. Where do you want to meet?
I've got a spot. I'm staying out in Venice this week, quiet, kind of romantic actually
Sounds perfect. Want me to swing by and grab you?
I'd like that. Or we could meet somewhere first and head back after?
Whatever works for you. I booked a little Airbnb close by just in case
Perfect, we'll figure it out when you get here 😘
I'm out front of the cafe, like we said
Two minutes out! 😊
Morning, handsome. Last night was everything
Morning. It was for me too
You leave today... I'm already not okay about it
Don't be sad. I promise this isn't the last time
On the train now. Thank you for two incredible days
Thank you, Miles. Missing you already, and you just left
Missing you too. Counting down till I get to hold you again
Get home safe. Text me the second you land ❤️
I promise, Mar 💕
Did you make it home safe?
Yeah, home now. Already miss you
Same here ❤️
Battery only? Lucky, mine was the alternator and it was four figures
Do not say that out loud, mine is old enough to hear you
😂 fair
Oh not bad at all, I feared worse
Restaurant Friday night?
definitely, anywhere in mind?
That Italian place we always go to, been ages
great, I'll make the booking
Yep, but it's in better shape than before 😇
Somehow that worries me more…
Game at mine Friday night?
Okay, I'll bring chips and beer 🍺
And nothing shrimp flavored this time 😅
Flat tire on the freeway… brilliant start to the day
No way. Want me to drive out?
It's fine, tow truck is on the way
New florist booked! Costs more but she is brilliant
Amazing! Now you can breathe
Yeah kind of... there’s still so much left to do
One at a time, Dee! The hard part is behind you
2 months to go... the panic is setting in
Completely normal! It will all come together
I hope so... okay I gotta run
Go on! You've got this 💪
Averaged 6.1L/100 on the back roads, not bad right?
Nice one. You were barely touching it
Game yesterday... boring 0-0
No spark up front
Found a great cleaner for fabric seats
Send me the name
Photo coming
Thanks bro
wild night yesterday! felt good
Yeah! just like the old days
I miss you guys... the distance is rough
us too Corey! but you come back often
heading back to Los Angeles on the 6 p.m. train
safe travels! see you soon man
thanks man! I'll keep you posted
Yep, I finish early so I'll swing by around 7
Great, the famous chocolate cake is coming with me 🍫
Dug up photos of us at summer camp 😂
Oh no... please not the cow costume pic 🐄
Too late… that one is going on your birthday card
Any luck finding grandma a gift?
Not yet, I keep going back and forth between a scarf and a book
A book, at least she can read while grandpa watches football 📖

questions.prompt: Sorry, I know this is a lot to drop on you. I just want to make sure this is actually his phone. You already know his first name is Miles, so can you give me his last name to confirm?
questions.hint: Open Settings. The name at the very top of the screen is the phone owner's own.

questions.prompt: That's definitely his phone, but I don't have the courage to check the messages myself. What name is that suspicious contact saved under?
questions.hint: Open Messages and look for the chat whose contact name reads like a warning, not a person's name.

questions.prompt: I'm still in shock... We need to find out her name! Maybe they gave each other some kind of nickname.
questions.hint: Open Messages → the chat with "Do not pick up" → scroll to the most recent texts, near the bottom.

questions.prompt: So we already have a clue... But I'm still curious about this girl with the nickname "Mar". Try to find out which app they met through.
questions.hint: Open Messages → the chat with "Do not pick up" → scroll to the very top of the thread.

questions.prompt: Wow... what a surprise, Miles Draper, you scumbag. I'm going to get to the bottom of this... He picked the place for their first date. What kind of food did he take her out for?
questions.hint: Open Messages → the chat with "Do not pick up" → near the top, they talk about food for the first date.

questions.prompt: Italian... typical man. He took me to an Italian place on our first date too, but he's not stupid enough to take her somewhere we've already been. Could you help me find the name of that restaurant?
questions.hint: Check Calendar for the "Tinder Date" event, then look up its address in Google Maps.

questions.prompt: The night he stopped responding to me, he skipped his work Airbnb and booked another place just for that night. What's the name of that place?
questions.hint: Open Airbnb and check his past stays for the extra one-night booking.

questions.prompt: He slept with "Mar"?! Could you help me find out how much he paid to spend the night with her?
questions.hint: Open RevoBank — the charge at the top of the list.

questions.prompt: That's a lot of money — and I just kept texting him like a fool. What excuse did he give me that night, so he could go sleep with her?
questions.hint: Open Messages → the chat with Casey 💖 → near the bottom, the morning-after text.

questions.prompt: There are hidden photos on here I'm not meant to see, I know there are. Can you get me the code for the hidden photos?
questions.hint: Open Notes → the note titled "Bits and pieces".
